aliases_and_boundary: Bullywug / Bullywugs. Use Kamstra's player package. Keep Grung and other amphibian folk separate.
Fomorian / Fomorians. Scope to this player giant and its printed curse abilities.
Fungi / Fungus. Keep Gas Spore, Shrieker, and Violet Fungus in one profile. Myconid and Mycelial have separate rules.
Gorgon / Gorgons. The armored bovine creature is separate from Medusa and cattle profiles.
Hell Hound / Hellhound. Keep the player fiend separate from Death Dog, Shadow Mastiff, and Yeth Hound.
Mephit / Mephits. Keep Dust, Ice, Magma, Mud, Smoke, and Steam together under one player profile.
Modron / Modrons. Keep Monodrone, Duodrone, Tridrone, Quadrone, and Pentadrone together. Use the independents described in the player rules.
Nightmare / Nightmares. Scope to the fiendish steed's player package. Keep other equine profiles separate.
Oni / Ogre Mage as an alternate name. Use Kamstra's traits. The encounter shapeshifting and innate spells have their own scope alongside other Ogre profiles.
Owlbear / Owlbears. Use this player conversion and keep encounter stat blocks separate.
Pegasus / Pegasi. Use the player version. Pegataur and Hippogriff remain separate.
Piercer / Piercers. Keep its player movement and climbing limits. The related Roper has its own package.
Pseudodragon / Pseudo-dragon. Keep distinct from Faerie Dragon and familiar rules.
Purple Worm / Purple Worms. Use player-scale size and its printed anatomy and attacks. Keep Neothelid separate.
Remorhaz / Remorhazes. Use this player conversion. The encounter Young Remorhaz stays separate.
Roc / Rocs. Scope to the player bird's printed size and flight. Keep the encounter roc and other birds separate.
Roper / Ropers. Scope to its own player trait block. Piercer and Cave Fisher keep separate profiles.
Scarecrow / Scarecrows. Use the player construct and its printed terrors. Keep other animated constructs separate.
Shield Guardian / Shield Guardians. The printed player guardian has broken its amulet bond. Helmed Horror remains separate.
Slaad / Slaadi. Group Red, Blue, Green/Gray/Death, and Tadpole in one profile. Treat Gray and Death as the printed Green progression, with their shared statistics.
Specter / Spectre. Keep the player spirit distinct from Banshee, Wraith, and other incorporeal profiles.
Stirge / Stirges. Use the individual player creature and the supplement's Tiny rules. Keep swarms separate.
Tarrasque / Tarrasques. Use Kamstra's player-scale traits. The solo encounter monster has separate rules.
Unicorn / Unicorns. Keep the player celestial separate from Ki-rin and other equine creatures.
Water Weird / Water Weirds. Keep its printed environmental dependence. Other elementals remain separate.
Will-o’-Wisp / Will-o'-Wisp / Will o' Wisp. Keep the player undead separate from lights, spells, and Wraith.
Wraith / Wraiths. Use the player incorporeal undead. Specter and any encounter-created servants retain their own scopes.
Wyvern / Wyverns. Use the player's anatomy and venom. Keep Dragon Turtle, Faerie Dragon, and other draconic entries separate.
Xorn / Xorns. Keep the stone traversal and other player traits together. Galeb Duhr and Rockborn stay separate.
Yeti / Yetis. Use the printed player package. Keep the Abominable Yeti encounter version separate.
Awakened Shrub / Awakened Shrubs. Use its dedicated player trait block. Awakened Tree and other plant folk are separate.
Axe Beak / Axebeak. Use the awakened player beast. Keep encounter statistics separate.
Blink Dog / Blink Dogs. Use the player creature's own movement. Keep other canid profiles separate.
Death Dog / Death Dogs. Use the two-headed player creature and its printed traits. Hell Hound keeps its own profile.

aliases_and_boundary: Giant Fire Beetle / Fire Beetle in context. Use this awakened player beast and its printed body size. Encounter beetles keep their own records.

Quickling / Quicklings. Use the printed player's speed and defensive feature. Separate from sprites and other tiny fey.
Sea Spawn / Sea-Spawn. Group the printed piscine adaptations as options. Deep Scion is a separate template.
Shadow Mastiff / Shadow Mastiffs. Use its player package. Keep Shadow Mastiff Alpha and other encounter canids separate.
Slithering Tracker / Slithering Trackers. Keep its own ooze profile separate from Oozefolk and other ooze families.

Trapper / Trappers. Use the monster-derived player creature, separate from the profession, Cloaker, and Animated Object.
Vargouille / Vargouilles. Use the flying fiend's traits. Keep Flameskull and Demilich separate.
